attempted_claim: The named 3-regular acyclic Borel graph E3 satisfies chi'_B(E3)=5 while chi'_mu(E3)=4: no Borel proper edge coloring with 4 colors exists, yet a measurable proper edge coloring with 4 colors exists.
claim_type: Borel-versus-measurable edge chromatic index gap 5 versus 4
decisive_failure: Full-text proofs of the Csoka-Lippner-Pikhurko and Grebik-Pikhurko measurable Vizing theorems were not reproduced in-session (only abstracts consulted); the infinitary edge-determinacy lower bound was shown out of reach rather than impossible in principle, so a future multi-day game-theoretic construction could still revive the target.
